headline: Argentina Country Risk Surges 14% as Global Market Volatility Spreads
summary: Argentina's sovereign risk indicator surged 14% to its highest level since late 2025 as global market sell-offs hit Argentine dollar debt securities and overseas equity receipts.
why: JPMorgan's EMBI risk index tracks the yield premium investors require to hold emerging market sovereign debt against benchmark U.S. Treasuries.

impacts.name: Argentina Sovereign Bond Yield
impacts.why: Global risk aversion triggered sharp price declines across Argentine sovereign dollar bonds.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A global sell-off in risk assets sparked heavy selling across foreign-denominated Argentine sovereign bonds.
